crossRefs.note: You shall speak to all who are wise-hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they make Aaron’s…
Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all…
“Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom Yahweh has put wisdom and understanding to know…
He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in Yahweh’s house, where the women wove hangings for…
Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven…
and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.
Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him…
I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all…
Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and…

translations.web: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun: the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
translations.bsb: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen.
translations.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
translations.asv: And all the women that were wise-hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, and the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
